It shall be assisted by a small high-powered Secretariat whose main
responsibility is to ensure the efficiency and effectiveness of the NCCE. It shall be
composed of a Director, a permanent staff of five (5) and o$ers seconded to the Council
as needed from the three (3) member agencies.

In the discharge of its functions and responsibilities, the NCCE may
commission highly-qualified experts/specialists and/or education consultancy groups to
p~ovide specified services.

It shall adopt its own internal operating rules and procedures and define
the duties and responsibilities of the Secretariat, its staffing pattern, and compensation~ched

The NCCE shall submit an annual performance report to the Presiden4
as well as program and policy recommendations affecting the entire education system.

In no case whatsoever shall the NCCE detract from the autonomy and
independence ofDECS, TESDA and CHED.,

Statistics for Educational Planning -For the purpose of carrying out
the mandates of the NCCE, the National Statistics Office (NSO) is hereby directed to
strengthen its core or basic unit responsible for the generation and analysis of education
and training statistics and to systematize its operational links with the st':ltistical units in
the Department of Education, Culture and Sports, Commission on Higher Education and
Technical Education and Skills Development Authority.
The NCCE shall coordinate
with the NSO in all matters pertaining to the generation, analysis, utilization
dissemination of all educational statistics and infonnation.

Government agencies are hereby directed to second and/or detail
competent individuals to the NCCE as may be requested.
